title: Right-action evaluation of the tensor mate of an arbitrary arrow
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories, with bifunctors $\otimes_{\mathcal C}:\mathcal C\times\mathcal C\to\mathcal C$ and $\otimes_{\mathcal D}:\mathcal D\times\mathcal D\to\mathcal D$, both denoted $\otimes$. Let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ have a specified adjunction $L\dashv R$ with natural unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to RL$ and counit $\varepsilon:LR\to\mathrm{id}$ satisfying the triangle identities [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Fix a natural isomorphism $\mu_{M,P}:L(M\otimes P)\xrightarrow{\sim}LM\otimes LP$. For each $K\in\mathcal C$, $E\in\mathcal D$, and morphism $c:LK\to E$, put
$$F_K(P)=K\otimes P,\quad H_E(P)=E\otimes LP,\quad G_E=RH_E,\quad \beta^c_P=(c\otimes1_{LP})\mu_{K,P},\quad \alpha^c_P=R(\beta^c_P)\eta_{K\otimes P}.$$
Fix objects $\mathbf1_{\mathcal C},\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}$, natural isomorphisms $\rho^{\mathcal C}_X:X\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\xrightarrow{\sim}X$ and $\rho^{\mathcal D}_Y:Y\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$, and an isomorphism $u:L\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}$. Suppose for every $M\in\mathcal C$ that
$$\rho^{\mathcal D}_{LM}(1_{LM}\otimes u)\mu_{M,\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=L(\rho^{\mathcal C}_M).$$
Put $k_E=\rho^{\mathcal D}_E(1_E\otimes u):E\otimes L\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\to E$. For every $K,E,c:LK\to E$, the following equalities hold:
$$k_E\beta^c_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=cL(\rho^{\mathcal C}_K),\qquad R(k_E)\alpha^c_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=R(c)\eta_K\rho^{\mathcal C}_K.$$
The first equality is in $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(L(K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}),E)$ and the second in $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C},RE)$. No associator, left unitor, shift, exactness, or monoidal coherence data beyond the displayed right-action equation are assumed.

proof.text: Bifunctoriality gives $(1_E\otimes u)(c\otimes1_{L\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}})=(c\otimes1_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}})(1_{LK}\otimes u)$: both sides are $c\otimes u$. Naturality of $\rho^{\mathcal D}$ at $c:LK\to E$ says $\rho^{\mathcal D}_E(c\otimes1_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}})=c\rho^{\mathcal D}_{LK}$. Thus, by the definition of $k$, $k_E(c\otimes1_{L\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}})=c k_{LK}$, as maps $LK\otimes L\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\to E$.

source.place: Tag 0B56, equation-projection-formula-map and its adjunct description; agent-written right-action calculation from the hypotheses.

proof.text: Compose the preceding equality on the right with $\mu_{K,\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}$. By the defining formula for $\beta^c$ and the assumed right-action equation at $M=K$, $$k_E\beta^c_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=c\rho^{\mathcal D}_{LK}(1_{LK}\otimes u)\mu_{K,\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=cL(\rho^{\mathcal C}_K).$$ Each expression has source $L(K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C})$ and target $E$.

source.place: Tag 0B56, equation-projection-formula-map and its adjunct description; agent-written right-action calculation from the hypotheses.

proof.text: Use the natural unit supplied in [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Its naturality at $\rho^{\mathcal C}_K:K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\to K$ reads $RL(\rho^{\mathcal C}_K)\eta_{K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=\eta_K\rho^{\mathcal C}_K$. Functoriality of $R$, the definition of $\alpha^c$, and step 2 now give $$R(k_E)\alpha^c_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=R(k_E\beta^c_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}})\eta_{K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=R(c)RL(\rho^{\mathcal C}_K)\eta_{K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=R(c)\eta_K\rho^{\mathcal C}_K.$$ This is the required equality from $K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}$ to $RE$.

lean.statement: theorem tensorArrowMate_right_unit {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D] (TC : C × C ⥤ C) (TD : D × D ⥤ D) (L : C ⥤ D) (R : D ⥤ C) (adj : L ⊣ R) (mu : TC ⋙ L ≅ L.prod L ⋙ TD) (oneC : C) (oneD : D) (rhoC : (𝟭 C).prod' ((Functor.const C).obj oneC) ⋙ TC ≅ 𝟭 C) (rhoD : (𝟭 D).prod' ((Functor.const D).obj oneD) ⋙ TD ≅ 𝟭 D) (u : L.obj oneC ≅ oneD) (right_action : ∀ M : C, mu.hom.app (M, oneC) ≫ TD.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (L.obj M)) u.hom) ≫ rhoD.hom.app (L.obj M) = L.map (rhoC.hom.app M)) (K : C) (E : D) (c : L.obj K ⟶ E) : (mu.hom.app (K, oneC) ≫ TD.map (Prod.mkHom c (𝟙 (L.obj oneC)))) ≫ (TD.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 E) u.hom) ≫ rhoD.hom.app E) = L.map (rhoC.hom.app K) ≫ c ∧ (adj.unit.app (TC.obj (K, oneC)) ≫ R.map (mu.hom.app (K, oneC) ≫ TD.map (Prod.mkHom c (𝟙 (L.obj oneC))))) ≫ R.map (TD.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 E) u.hom) ≫ rhoD.hom.app E) = rhoC.hom.app K ≫ adj.unit.app K ≫ R.map c
